critical_code_review_comments: MODEL GAP: TicketStatus enum in /app/backend/models.py lacks 'cancelado' (only EM_COBRANCA/PAGO/BLOQUEADO/PROPOSTA/ABERTO/FECHADO). However /api/crm/clients/{id}/timeline excludes 'cancelado' from the open count. Today PUT /api/crm/tickets/{id} {status:'cancelado'} returns 422, so that exclusion branch is unreachable from the product. Either add CANCELADO to the enum OR drop 'cancelado' from the open-count filter to keep behavior consistent.

LIMIT SEMANTICS: stats are computed over the LIMITED list (sum/count of the N most recent tickets). If a company has >50 tickets on one client, stats.total_tickets/total_value will under-count. Either document that limit caps stats, or run stats via db.tickets.count_documents + aggregate pipeline independent from the paginated list. Suggested: use separate aggregation for totals and keep the limit only for the returned tickets[].
N+1-ISH: current impl fetches up to `limit` tickets and does Python-side sum/count. Fine for <500 tickets; if client history grows big, prefer a MongoDB $group aggregation.
GET mutates on cold ticket still applies (iter38 carryover) — not affecting this route.
Timeline tickets projection omits 'updated_at' but frontend sorts/displays by 'created_at' only — consistent. No bug.
